cases.rationale: Independent baseline and candidate lots, frozen TOST plan, method receipts and matching result lineage.
Distinct specimens are paired by the exact same three independent production lots; each lot pair counts once.
Four coupons per arm do not create two independent lots when all coupons come from one lot.
Independent-arm design reuses the same material lot in both arms.
Paired-by-cluster design has different baseline and candidate cluster sets.
Plan freeze follows first outcome availability.
Analysis result uses a margin different from the preregistered plan.
Power/precision planning is not linked to the frozen design digest.
Analysis result does not bind the same actual specimen manifest as the design receipt.
The referenced power/precision calculation receipt has no valid digest.
The method-qualified observation is not linked to the same specimens used in the statistical analysis.
Invalid or excluded samples require a reason reference.
Observed specimen and cluster attrition exceeds the preregistered allowance.
Coupon is the observation unit, not an eligible independent manufacturing unit for this profile.
For two one-sided tests at alpha .05, the corresponding two-sided interval is 90%, not 95%.
The study design is structurally valid but its interval crosses the lower equivalence margin; no equivalence is established.
A planning receipt cannot claim observed power or certify the experiment.
The design endpoint must match the endpoint actually measured by both method-qualified receipts.
Paired-by-cluster designs count paired clusters as the independent unit.
Power calculation must bind the exact low/central/high variance and effect-assumption digest.
Variance scenario envelope must be ordered low <= central <= high.
Randomization protocol reference is required before outcomes.
A zero assumed effect cannot substantiate a power target for a non-zero transfer effect.
